                                 Table 6.1: Comparison of different methods for estimating the number of cells in a microscopic image.



 | Method | Advantages | Disadvantages | Accuracy | Time Consumption |
 |---|---|---|---|---|
 | Manual Counting | Simple to implement, no specialized equipment needed | Subjective, time-consuming, prone to errors | Low to moderate | High |
 | Thresholding | Relatively fast, can handle large images | Sensitive to noise and variations in image intensity | Moderate | Moderate |
 | Watershed Segmentation | Can separate touching cells | Computationally expensive, parameter tuning required | Moderate to high | High |
 | Machine Learning (e.g., CNN) | High accuracy, robust to noise | Requires training data, computationally intensive | High | Moderate to high |
